name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (Class 9-10)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: Financial assistance to SC/ST students in Classes 9-10 to prevent dropout and encourage continuation of education.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in (NSP portal) between July-October

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Class 11 to PhD)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Full fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for SC students from Class 11 to doctoral level.
benefits: Full tuition fee + ₹380-1,200/month maintenance allowance depending on level

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Class 11 to PhD)
description: Financial support for ST students pursuing post-matric education from Class 11 to doctoral level.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Maintenance allowance for OBC students pursuing post-matric education to reduce dropout due to financial constraints.
eligibility: OBC (non-creamy layer) students from Class 11 onwards

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students (Class 1-10)
description: Financial support for minority community students from Class 1 to 10 to ensure access to education.
eligibility: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Zoroastrian students

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students (Class 11 to PhD)
description: Financial support for minority students pursuing post-matric education.
eligibility: Minority community students from Class 11 onwards

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minority Students
description: Scholarship for minority students pursuing technical/professional courses (engineering, medical, management) at undergraduate level.
eligibility: Minority community students in technical/professional UG courses

name: Central Sector Scholarship for College/University Students
description: Merit-based scholarship for top-performing students who scored above 80th percentile in Class 12 board exams.
eligibility: Students who scored above 80th percentile in Class 12 board exams
benefits: ₹10,000/year for UG (first 3 years) + ₹20,000/year for PG (2 years)

name: INSPIRE Scholarship (SHE)
description: Scholarship for students pursuing natural sciences at BSc/BS/MSc level to attract talent to science research.
eligibility: Top 1% in Class 12 board exams (science stream)
Enrolled in BSc/BS/MSc in natural sciences at recognized institution
documents: Class 12 marks with top 1% certificate from board

name: PM Research Fellowship (PMRF)
description: Prestigious fellowship for students pursuing PhD in IITs, IISc, NITs, and IISERs in science and technology.
eligibility: BTech/BE/MSc graduates with 8.0+ CGPA from premier institutions
Pursuing or admitted to PhD at IIT/IISc/NIT/IISER
how_to_apply: Apply at pmrf.in during open calls (typically Jan-Feb)

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
description: Scholarship to meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in Class 9-12 to prevent dropout.
eligibility: Students in Class 9 (after NMMS exam in Class 8)
how_to_apply: Apply through school after qualifying state-level NMMS exam

name: PM YASHASVI Scholarship (OBC/EBC/DNT Students)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Merit-based scholarship for OBC, EBC (Economically Backward Classes), and DNT (De-notified Tribes) students in Class 9-12.
eligibility: OBC/EBC/DNT students in Class 9 or Class 11
how_to_apply: Appear for YASHASVI test (conducted by NTA) and apply at scholarships.gov.in
deadline: July-August for test; September-October for scholarship

name: Ishan Uday Scholarship (NE Students)
description: Special scholarship for students from North Eastern states pursuing undergraduate courses outside their home state.
eligibility: Domicile of 8 NE states (Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura, Arunachal)
Enrolled in UG courses outside home state

name: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Scholarship
description: Scholarship for single girl child (only child in family) pursuing postgraduate education.
eligibility: Single girl child (parents have only one child — a daughter)
Enrolled in PG courses at recognized university
documents: Single girl child affidavit from parents

name: National Talent Search (NTS) Scholarship
ministry: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
description: Prestigious national scholarship for meritorious students identified through two-stage NTS examination.
eligibility: Students in Class 10 qualifying NTS Stage 1 (state level) and Stage 2 (national level) exams
how_to_apply: Appear for state-level NTS exam through school

name: JEE Main (Joint Entrance Exam) — Engineering Admissions
description: National entrance exam for admission to NITs, IIITs, CFTIs and as qualifying exam for JEE Advanced (IITs).
eligibility: Maximum 2 attempts per year, 2 consecutive years
benefits: Gateway to engineering admissions in 31 NITs, 25 IIITs, 28 CFTIs
how_to_apply: Register at jeemain.nta.nic.in (Session 1: Jan-Feb, Session 2: Apr)

name: NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / NTA
description: National level medical entrance exam for admission to MBBS, BDS, AYUSH courses in government and private medical colleges.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Physics, Chemistry, Biology
benefits: Admission to 90,000+ MBBS/BDS seats in government and private colleges

name: CUET-UG (Common University Entrance Test)
description: Common entrance test for undergraduate admissions to all central universities including DU, BHU, JNU, AMU, and 200+ universities.
eligibility: Subject combinations as per university requirements
No age restriction for most universities
benefits: Single exam for admission to 250+ universities across India
how_to_apply: Register at cuet.samarth.ac.in (exam typically in May-June)

name: PM Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Portal
ministry: Ministry of Education / Ministry of Finance
description: Single portal for students to apply for education loans from 38 banks. Covers all domestic and foreign education programs.
eligibility: Indian students admitted to recognized courses
No income limit for loan application
Loan up to ₹7.5 lakh (no collateral), above ₹7.5 lakh (with collateral)
benefits: Education loans at subsidized interest. Interest subsidy under CSIS for EWS students (income < ₹4.5L)
how_to_apply: Apply at vidyalakshmi.co.in — single application to multiple banks

name: PM USHA (Uttam Shiksha Abhiyan) — Higher Education
description: Multidisciplinary Education and Research Improvement in State Universities (MERISU) to upgrade state university infrastructure and quality.
eligibility: Students at participating state universities and affiliated colleges
Focus on research, innovation, and skill development
benefits: Infrastructure improvement, research grants, internship opportunities at upgraded state universities
how_to_apply: Automatic for students enrolled in participating state universities
